sharedFileOwnership.rule: Only svc-p08 is dispatched. Its writePaths are disjoint from all accepted plan paths, and sharedPaths is empty. The worker edits only its writePaths and its own Progress Log. It never edits: this manifest, the g1-g9 manifests, impl-plans/README.md, impl-plans/logs/**, README.md, src/**, db/**, impl-plans/active/inventory-alert-boundaries.md, or another plan's files. It never runs git checkout, restore, stash, reset, clean, commit, add or push. Per-edit discipline: read the file fresh before each edit; record pre/post SHA-256 hashes and an immutable intent snapshot under the evidence root; check for drift. If an owned file's hash changed outside the worker's own edits, write a Reconciliation request and never overwrite it.
sharedFileOwnership.dependencies: No dependency or lockfile change. Do not run uv lock or edit pyproject.toml, uv.lock, src/web/package.json or src/web/bun.lock.
sharedFileOwnership.reconciliation: A defect in production code or in an accepted plan's file is a Reconciliation request in the svc-p08 Progress Log, reproduced by a failing test id. Owner diagnosis rule: serial finalization reproduces it and fixes the root cause in the owning plan's paths; workers never make cross-plan edits. Directory-stream GAP/conflict retries are expected behavior, not a defect. The copied-row recipient_unknown race in R10.1 step 4 is resolved inside svc-p08 writePaths (test order plus design section 13/17 and command.md runbook text) and is also recorded in the Progress Log.

The implementation is done; only the cutover delivery/dedup proof, the leak-matrix non-vacuity fix and the final gates remain.
requiredOutcomes: R1R8 (a) replay and (b) stopped-Telescreen: already passing; must stay green in the 3x repeat gate.

R1R8 (c): after notification-store copy and verify, the copied queued member:alice notification is delivered exactly once, and the inventory retention command whose event id equals a copied receipt id returns DUPLICATE with no second notification.

The leak matrix enumerates db/ownership.py tables_for for all three stores and scans every row, the process logs, the API bodies, the SMTP DATA and both audit exports, with no raw or JSON-escaped sample. Non-vacuity: ingest 200, a findings row with a masked snippet, scan_jobs.findings_count > 0.
mise run ci, ddl-check, web-ci and uv build pass, and the plans and manifests are archived.
nonGoals: No production code, DDL or migration change in svc-p08.
No positive ProducerRedactionHits or dlp_hit_count requirement.
No new multi-process cases for OIDC parity, DLP parity, the settings proxy or collection.
No live PostgreSQL, Mailpit or Keycloak checks (owner-run).
No re-implementation or redispatch of svc-p01 to svc-p07.
constraints: English only, no emojis. Plans under 400 lines. Python files under 1000 lines.
Strict typing (typelint, ruff ANN/PGH, ty). No Any, object, dict or **kwargs, and no type-ignore.
Raw detected values, raw item keys and source content never enter any table, log, outbox, replica, wire message, notification, export or API response.

Default uv run pytest passes offline. Process tests use ephemeral ports, bounded polling (at most 90 s), append-mode logs, readiness waits after every (re)start, outbox drain before stopping a producer, and termination in finally.
Conventions 7a: only final passing commands; priorVerification empty; addressedFeedback only fixed findings.
Commit and push only to feat/service-split.
designDecisionsAndRationale: D1-D5 and C1-C9/O1 of design-service-split.md stand unchanged. Cross-service delivery is at least once through durable outboxes and idempotent inbox receipts.
NotificationStatus has no pending value; unsent monolith rows are queued, and senders store handle-based member refs (owner resolution 3).
Retention dedup works because event_id = retention_event_id(asset, due field, due revision) equals the copied receipt id (sections 8 and 9).
Producers redact content before building commands, so ProducerRedactionHits of zero is correct; non-vacuity is proven at ingest (owner resolution 3).

Notification fails a member row with recipient_unknown if its replica lacks the member. If reproduced in R10.1, the cutover seeds the replica by resync before the stopped-writer copy; notification-store copy keeps notification_directory_entries.
intentionalTradeoffs: Process tests wait up to 90 s per condition (cron minute alignment plus delivery backoff); the 3x repeat gate detects flakiness.
PostgreSQL restricted-login and live Mailpit/Keycloak checks stay owner-run, because agents have no TELESCREEN_TEST_* variables.
supportedEdgeCases: Copied queued member row with an empty Notification replica at start (R10.1 step 4).
Overdue cron fires once per cron minute, so it is enabled only by restarting Inventory after the asset and replica exist.
Copied retention receipt makes the inventory command a DUPLICATE before an inbox claim (notification_service/inbox.py:62-74).
A store table missing from its SQLite file fails the leak matrix.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Restricted-login PostgreSQL cross-store denial and live Mailpit/Keycloak delivery (owner-run; skipped offline).
Multi-process OIDC parity, DLP parity, settings proxy and collection flows.
Directory-stream GAP/conflict retry counts (expected behavior; tests wait for state only).
The 11 older frameless inventory handoff tables in the Nodetto layout.
